新 iPad mini 8 用了两天了，这台机器的手感是非常惊艳的，和 iPhone duo 相比

1. 重量仅增加了 1g
2. 厚度仅增加了 0.2毫米
3. 价格是 Duo 的三分之一
4.不能折叠，携带不够方便，但同时没有任何折痕，看起来棒极了

iPad mini 8 另外比较惊喜的地方是，在 iPad 上第一次用了防尘防水设计，可以在浴室使用了。
新设计做到了机身更加轻薄的同时还提升了音质，可谓非常用心。
总体而言，是非常质变的一代，值得入手。
甚至可能太完美了吧，屏幕刷新率被 Apple 用软件锁死在了 60 hz，为 Duo 大哥让出 C 位。
既生瑜何生亮。

quoted_tweet.author: Drashya Kuruwa
quoted_tweet.text:
Finallyyy.. I got it @icreatelife 😊🙏

Months ago, a few of us were just experimenting and dropping ideas onto a shared digital canvas. I had almost forgotten how it felt when we were all creating together on that @AdobeFirefly board. To be honest, I didn't think the mail from NY would ever actually reach me here in Ahmedabad, India.

Then it showed up for Diwali. 🪔

Flipping through "Gallery of the Future" felt like opening a time capsule. And seeing my little piece of imagination printed on the "JOURNEY" spread, sitting right next to @DrSadek_ whose breathtaking worlds have inspired me for ages, honestly made me pause and just take it all in.

Thank you so much, Kris @icreatelife 🙏🙏. You didn't just curate a zine, you gave 40 strangers across the world a  memory to hold onto. Grateful to share this page with @DrSadek_ and @barbbowman. ✨
